Run `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test` and `npm run build`. Offline tests use saved, sanitized fixtures and assert that no unexpected network request is made. Bandsintown mostly links out to the actual ticketer, so following through to a supported ticketer is the preferred path when it is legitimate.

**Related:** #144 (bot-block detection and fallback), #152 (listed Bandsintown as unverified; this issue resolves it).
**Priority:** P2, post-v1. **Required for v1:** No. **Issue key:** new (pending triage). **Owner role:** Product and frontend.

<!-- geo-coverage:2026-10-14 -->

- **Evidence:** Official city pages exist for London and Tokyo (seen via search-indexed snippets; the site returns 403 to direct fetches), so confidence is medium.

Coverage is taken from the providers' own sites, help centres or country domains, checked 2026-10-14. It is not inferred from headquarters. Regions not listed are **unknown**, not excluded. Evidence marked as a snippet was seen through search-indexed copies of official pages because the site blocks direct requests. Priority is unchanged: **P2**, post-v1 / nice to have; **Required for v1:** No.

## Current architecture (shared context)

At [main 3ded858](https://github.com/Jevelopers-neatHack-2026/getticketstub.com/tree/3ded8581283ba0890b77659c996c1cee107c6cf9), only Ticketmaster / Live Nation links get **dedicated, tested support**. Demo mode answers non-fixture links with `demo_only`. Luma is tracked separately in #142. Bulk pasting (#141) should validate and dedupe on whatever canonical URL this work defines.

| --- | --- |
| Domains | `bandsintown.com` → 301 → `www.bandsintown.com`. Event URL form `www.bandsintown.com/e/{id}-{slug}`; a past event redirected to a `/z/…` page in the earlier survey |
| Probes today | Homepage **and** a past event page (`/e/105543564-…`) both return **403 Cloudflare "Attention Required!"**. **Changed:** the same event page returned 200 with a top-level `MusicEvent` earlier in this survey. Access is inconsistent, and the result may depend on IP or request scoring |
| Generic parsing | When readable: `MusicEvent` JSON-LD (verified once). When blocked: the generic HTTP error |
| Official API | The [Bandsintown API](https://help.artists.bandsintown.com/en/articles/9186477-api-documentation) covers artist information and artist events (an app id is required); there is no lookup by event id |
| Not yet verified (implementation tasks) | Upcoming event pages; the `/z/` past-event form; `bnds.us` or other short links; whether the artist-events API can find the event behind an `/e/{id}` link (matching artist, date and venue) under its terms |

**Classification: blocked today (confirmed); the readable state seen earlier is intermittent (uncertain).**

## Scope

- `bandsintown.ts`: recognise `www.bandsintown.com/e/{id}-{slug}` (canonical id), the `/z/` form, and verified short links. Artist (`/a/…`), venue and city pages are non-events.
- **Read order:**
  1. If the page is readable, map the `MusicEvent` (lineup, venue, city, date). If it links to a ticketer the app already supports (Ticketmaster family, Eventbrite, DICE, etc.), offer to use that link.
  2. If blocked, classify as `access_restricted` and show a Bandsintown-specific message plus the fallback, prefilled from the slug ("{artist} at {venue}").
  3. Optional: the artist-events API lookup, if the owner approves its terms and app id.
- No retry loops or bypass after a challenge.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Recognition tests: `/e/{id}-{slug}`, `/z/` and verified short links, artist and venue refusals, lookalikes.
- [ ] A saved readable `MusicEvent` fixture maps to lineup, venue, city and date with `source: "Bandsintown"`.
- [ ] A saved Cloudflare 403 fixture leads to the Bandsintown message plus a slug-prefilled fallback, never "Attention Required!" as a title.
- [ ] Ticketer hand-off: when the page names a supported ticketer link, the customer is offered it. Tested with a fixture.
- [ ] Verification results (upcoming events, short links, API terms) are recorded here. Offline in `npm test`.

Live checks happen only on Preview in live mode, with owner authorization, and record their mode. Before closure, attach the PR, the tested commit, fixture provenance and dates, and command results. ## Verified facts (2026-10-14)

| --- | --- |

- The operator is TICKETINO AG, Switzerland ([organizer site](https://organizer.ticketino.com/de/home)). That is context only; coverage rests on the region selector and listings above.
- Other countries are **unknown**; US: not evidenced.

Priority is unchanged: **P2**, post-v1 / nice to have; **Required for v1:** No.

Every other public link goes through **generic page parsing** in live mode only: [`fetchPage`](https://github.com/Jevelopers-neatHack-2026/getticketstub.com/blob/3ded8581283ba0890b77659c996c1cee107c6cf9/src/app/api/research/route.ts#L68) (app user agent `TicketStubResearch/0.1`, 8 s timeout, 2 MB cap, at most 3 validated redirects, no JavaScript) → [`extract`](https://github.com/Jevelopers-neatHack-2026/getticketstub.com/blob/3ded8581283ba0890b77659c996c1cee107c6cf9/src/app/api/research/route.ts#L241). `extract` reads the first schema.org Event-typed JSON-LD node (top level, `@graph` or `subEvent`; not `ItemList`) and otherwise falls back to a low-confidence `og:title` / `<title>`. ## Verified facts (2026-10-14)

| Item | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Hosts | `www.ticketino.com` (200, app user agent). `ticketino.ch` resets the connection; `ticketino.de` and `ticketino.at` fail TLS (unrecognised name). **Do not recognise** those three until verified |
| Event URL form | `www.ticketino.com/{lang}/Event/{slug}/{id}`, with `lang` one of `de`, `en`, `fr`, `it`. The `og:url` slug can differ from the link (`Zurich-Wine-Festival` vs `Zurich-Wine-Festival-2026`), so **canonicalise on the numeric id** |
| Structured data | A full schema.org `Event` (name, `startDate`, `endDate`, `doorTime`, Place with address and `addressCountry`, organizer, offers in CHF). Dates are **local time without an offset** (`2026-10-15T18:00`) |

The title fallback gives "Zurich Wine Festival 2026" and, most likely, **no date**: the title's `15. - 18.10.2026` date range isn't a format `guessDateFromText` reads. Confirm with a fixture |

- [ ] A saved CH event fixture maps "Zurich Wine Festival 2026", date `2026-10-15`, Papiersaal Zürich and Zurich, with `source: "TICKETINO"`. DE and AT fixtures map their own venue and country.
- [ ] An entity-encoded JSON-LD fixture is parsed by the generic path (added to #151).
- [ ] Saved `EventGroup` and `Genre` fixtures never become a single-date stub.
- [ ] Offline in `npm test`.

## Verified facts (2026-10-14)

Demo mode answers non-fixture links with `demo_only`. Luma is tracked separately in #142. Bulk pasting (#141) should validate and dedupe on whatever canonical URL this work defines.

Probe evidence below comes from 2026-10-14. Requests were made from a development machine with curl, using the app's exact user agent and accept header. Bot protection also scores TLS fingerprint and IP address, so results from the production host can differ. Re-check before implementing.

## Verified facts (2026-10-14)

| Item | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Event URL form | `www.fatsoma.com/e/{code}/{slug}` (8-character code). Listing pages are `/discover` (with `category-id`) |
| Event pages today | 200; parsed as `schema_org`, one Event node each, with Place, performer, organizer, offers, EventScheduled and OfflineEventAttendanceMode. **NJ:** "A Queen vs Elton John Candlelight Experience In Summit, NJ…", `startDate` `2026-11-20T19:00:00.000Z`, United Methodist Church of Summit. **UK:** "PROJECT HALLOWEEN 🎃 Manchester's Biggest Halloween Event! ❤️‍🔥 …", `2026-10-29T22:30:00.000Z`, Mayfield Depot |

| Item | Result |
| --- | --- |

| Structured data / API | **Unknown.** Partner or affiliate API availability and terms are a verification task (owner role) |

- While blocked: skip the fetch and show a KKday-specific message plus the manual-details fallback, prefilled from the slug. Ask the customer for the visit or event date, since many products are not dated in the URL. Never retry in a loop.
- **Verification tasks:** product URL forms, how to tell an event or dated admission from a tour or pass, the partner API option, and readability from the production host.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Verified URL forms, the product-type classification and the scope decision are recorded here before rules are merged.
- [ ] Recognition tests: product (in and out of scope), destination, blog, locale variants and lookalikes.
- [ ] A recognised in-scope link gives the KKday message and a fallback that asks for the date, and a fetch spy proves no request while blocked.
- [ ] A saved Cloudflare challenge fixture is `access_restricted`, never a generic error or a stub.
- [ ] Offline in `npm test`.

Run `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test` and `npm run build`. Offline tests use saved, sanitized fixtures and assert that no unexpected network request is made. Live checks happen only on Preview in live mode, with owner authorization, and record their mode. Before closure, attach the PR, the tested commit, fixture provenance and dates, and command results. Creating this issue does not claim implementation or passing tests.

Support Ticketmelon event links (`www.ticketmelon.com/{organizer}/{event}`). Ticketmelon is a ticketer for concerts and festivals in Thailand and Singapore. Sampled event pages have **no JSON-LD**, so the generic parser gives a title-only stub with no date or venue (**partial generic support**).

**Related:** #151 (generic-parser hardening).
**Priority:** P2. Post-v1 / nice to have. **Required for v1:** No. **Issue key:** new (pending triage). **Owner role:** Product and frontend. No earlier Ticketmelon issue exists (open or closed).

## Geographic coverage (verified 2026-10-14)
<!-- geo-coverage:2026-10-14 -->

**Ticketmelon: international, non-US. Observed event inventory: Thailand and Singapore.**

- Observed official listings: [SPEED Live in Bangkok 2026](https://www.ticketmelon.com/holdingonrecords/speedliveinbangkok) and [Bodyslam Live in Singapore 2026](https://www.ticketmelon.com/badboyent/BodyslamSG2026).
- Other Southeast Asian countries are **not** inferred from operator marketing; they are unverified. US: not evidenced.

Priority is unchanged: **P2**, post-v1 / nice to have; **Required for v1:** No.

## Current architecture (shared context)

At [main 3ded858](https://github.com/Jevelopers-neatHack-2026/getticketstub.com/tree/3ded8581283ba0890b77659c996c1cee107c6cf9), only Ticketmaster / Live Nation links get **dedicated, tested support**. That path is [`ticketmaster.ts`](https://github.com/Jevelopers-neatHack-2026/getticketstub.com/blob/3ded8581283ba0890b77659c996c1cee107c6cf9/src/customer/studio/research/ticketmaster.ts) (Discovery API v2, host regex `(ticketmaster|livenation).<tld>`) plus [`smoke-ticketmaster.mjs`](https://github.com/Jevelopers-neatHack-2026/getticketstub.com/blob/3ded8581283ba0890b77659c996c1cee107c6cf9/scripts/smoke-ticketmaster.mjs). Every other public link goes through **generic page parsing** in live mode only: [`fetchPage`](https://github.com/Jevelopers-neatHack-2026/getticketstub.com/blob/3ded8581283ba0890b77659c996c1cee107c6cf9/src/app/api/research/route.ts#L68) (app user agent `TicketStubResearch/0.1`, 8 s timeout, 2 MB cap, at most 3 validated redirects, no JavaScript) → [`extract`](https://github.com/Jevelopers-neatHack-2026/getticketstub.com/blob/3ded8581283ba0890b77659c996c1cee107c6cf9/src/app/api/research/route.ts#L241). `extract` reads the first schema.org Event-typed JSON-LD node (top level, `@graph` or `subEvent`; not `ItemList`) and otherwise falls back to a low-confidence `og:title` / `<title>`. Demo mode answers non-fixture links with `demo_only`. Luma is tracked separately in #142. Bulk pasting (#141) should validate and dedupe on whatever canonical URL this work defines.

Probe evidence below comes from 2026-10-14. Requests were made from a development machine with curl, using the app's exact user agent and accept header. Bot protection also scores TLS fingerprint and IP address, so results from the production host can differ. Re-check before implementing.

Observations come from sampled development requests (curl with the app user agent, 2026-10-14), not from the production host; re-check before implementing.

| Item | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Event URL form | `www.ticketmelon.com/{organizer}/{event}` (organiser-scoped, two path segments). Organiser pages (`/{organizer}`) are non-events |
| Event pages | Both 200, ~32 KB, **no JSON-LD**. Title-only stubs "SPEED Live in Bangkok 2026" and "Bodyslam Live in Singapore 2026". No date or venue is extracted; the title contains only the year |
| Data source | Whether a client API or embedded data gives the date and venue is a **verification task** |

## Scope

- `ticketmelon.ts`: recognise `ticketmelon.com` and `www.ticketmelon.com` two-segment event paths. Organiser pages, home and discovery pages are refused without a fetch.
- **Verification task first:** a supported date and venue source; otherwise use the manual-details fallback with the title prefilled.
- Local dates in the venue's timezone (Asia/Bangkok, Asia/Singapore).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Recognition tests: event paths, organiser pages, home and lookalikes.
- [ ] A **valid event page** fixture maps the title, local date, venue and city with `source: "Ticketmelon"` for a Bangkok and a Singapore event, or the documented fallback without an invented date.
- [ ] Saved **non-event, listing or blocked/error** fixtures give a specific outcome (refusal, `not_found` or `access_restricted` with the manual-details fallback) and are not turned into a stub (organiser page).
- [ ] Offline in `npm test`.

Demo mode answers non-fixture links with `demo_only`. Luma is tracked separately in #142. Bulk pasting (#141) should validate and dedupe on whatever canonical URL this work defines.

## Verified facts (2026-10-14)

Observations come from sampled development requests (curl with the app user agent, 2026-10-14), not from the production host; re-check before implementing.

| Item | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Waiting room | `dubai.platinumlist.net/event`, `riyadh.platinumlist.net/` and `platinumlist.net/` → 302 → `queue.platinumlist.net/?…e=protectallsite…` (Queue-it). Following redirects loops back with a `queueittoken`; the app stops at 3 redirects, so customers see a **generic error** |
